articles.title: FlightAware drops Kalshi lawsuit over a market niche that data shows it never took off
articles.snippet: The flight-tracking company voluntarily dismissed, without prejudice and without sharing a motive for its decision. However, the flight cancellation market never took off with Kalshi users.

articles.title: Crypto.com rolls out tokenized stock derivatives as crypto exchanges push into equities
articles.snippet: The exchange is joining a tokenized stock market that has grown 600% in a year, though its products offer price exposure rather than share ownership.

articles.title: Bitcoin stuck as ETF inflows offset selling, but inflation data could spark a move
articles.snippet: Weeks of sideways trading have crushed volatility, leaving Wednesday’s inflation report as the next potential catalyst, analysts said.

articles.title: CFTC orders Kalshi to continue offering prediction markets in New York after state lawsuit
articles.snippet: New York sued Kalshi last month in a bid to block it from operating sports-related prediction markets.

articles.title: Bitwise cuts 14% of staff while still expecting growth
articles.snippet: Crypto companies from including Coinbase, BitGo, Robinhood, Polygon and Pump.fun have announced workforce reductions this year, citing a variety of reasons, including shifting to AI and market forces.
